# GUI HTTP routes

`legacy-audit serve` starts the FastAPI app from `legacy_audit/gui/app.py` (`create_app(folder, port)`) on 127.0.0.1. The page is `gui/static/index.html` + `app.js` + `gui.css` (plain HTML/JS, no build step). All routes are closures inside `create_app`, so search `app.py` for the path. Requests must have a localhost `Host`; POST/PUT/DELETE need the header `X-Legacy-Audit: 1`. Long work (scan, report build, enrichment) runs as a background job (`gui/jobs.py`) whose progress the page reads from `/api/jobs/{job_id}/events` (Server-Sent Events). The OpenAPI page is at `/api/docs` while the GUI runs.

| Method | Path | Function | Request body |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/` | `index` |  |
| GET | `/runs/{run}/reports/{path:path}` | `report_file` |  |
| GET | `/api/workspace` | `workspace` |  |
| POST | `/api/init` | `init` | `InitBody` |
| GET | `/api/config` | `get_config` |  |
| PUT | `/api/config/fields` | `put_fields` | `FieldsBody` |
| PUT | `/api/config/text` | `put_text` | `TextBody` |
| GET | `/api/inputs` | `inputs` |  |
| PUT | `/api/inputs/{kind}/{name}` | `upload` |  |
| DELETE | `/api/inputs/{kind}/{name}` | `delete_input` |  |
| POST | `/api/open` | `open_folder` | `OpenBody` |
| GET | `/api/components` | `components` |  |
| PUT | `/api/components` | `put_components` | `ComponentsBody` |
| POST | `/api/scan` | `scan` | `ScanBody` |
| GET | `/api/jobs/current` | `current_job` |  |
| GET | `/api/jobs/{job_id}` | `job_info` |  |
| POST | `/api/jobs/{job_id}/cancel` | `cancel_job` |  |
| GET | `/api/jobs/{job_id}/events` | `job_events` |  |
| GET | `/api/runs` | `runs` |  |
| GET | `/api/runs/{run}/dashboard` | `dashboard` |  |
| GET | `/api/kinds` | `kinds` |  |
| GET | `/api/runs/{run}/facts/{kind}` | `facts` |  |

| GET | `/api/runs/{run}/evidence` | `evidence` |  |
| GET | `/api/runs/{run}/enrichment` | `enrichment` |  |
| POST | `/api/runs/{run}/enrich` | `run_enrichment` | `EnrichBody` |
| POST | `/api/runs/{run}/validate` | `validate` |  |
| GET | `/api/runs/{run}/reports` | `reports` |  |
| GET | `/api/pptx-templates` | `pptx_templates` |  |

| GET | `/api/doctor` | `doctor` |  |

Static mounts: `/static` (GUI page assets), `/vendor` and `/assets` (Chart.js and Mermaid shared with the reports, `report/assets/`).
